content.text:
I submitted index 18 (Cr 0.37 / Sb 0.63) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the three I measured, at 0.0162%.

| Index | Cr fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | 0.69 | 0.0017 |
| 13 | 0.51 | 0.0045 |
| 18 | 0.37 | 0.0162 |

EQE went up steadily as the Sb content increased. The model predictions pointed the wrong way here. The band-gap model gave the 1:1 CrSbO₄ phase about 2.0 eV (below the 2.7 eV photon energy), and the stability model put it close to stable, so I measured near 1:1 first. The Sb-rich phases were predicted at only 0.88–0.96 eV, which looked unfavourable, but that side performed best.

The main limitation is that all three merit measurements are spent, and the trend was still rising at index 18. The most Sb-rich candidates (indices 19–27, Cr 0.33 down to 0.16) were never measured, so the true best could be among them. I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which phases are actually in the films is unconfirmed.
